summary: Route Finder shows the real stand a parked aircraft is at, so you can start your flight from the same gate.
releaseNotes: Route Finder (Flying now): an aircraft parked at its departure or arrival airport shows its real stand or gate, matched from its live position to the stands charted in OpenStreetMap.
Flying now results say whether a flight is at the gate, has arrived, is taxiing or is airborne.
